question: How integration tests can observe a published event, and how the broker is configured under test
claim: ThingsBooksyWebAppFactory does not register any test-specific IMessageBroker/IOutboxBroker/IAsyncMessageDispatcher override; it only overrides postgres connection string, logger console/file flags, and management-groups/resources module-enabled flags via an in-memory config source, so the production DI registrations from AddMessaging/AddOutbox apply unchanged in tests. Messaging config comes from appsettings.json keys 'messaging:useAsyncDispatcher' (true) and 'outbox:enabled' (false, plus 'outbox:interval'), bound to MessagingOptions/OutboxOptions; appsettings.Development.json and appsettings.Docker.json only override postgres/logger keys, not messaging/outbox, and ThingsBooksyWebAppFactory's in-memory overrides also do not touch them — so tests run with outbox disabled and the async in-process dispatcher enabled. Because outbox is disabled, InMemoryMessageBroker.PublishAsync skips IOutboxBroker.SendAsync (outboxBroker.Enabled is false) and instead calls IAsyncMessageDispatcher.PublishAsync, which writes to an in-process Channel consumed by a hosted AsyncDispatcherJob; EfOutbox.SaveAsync (which would populate the Outbox DbSet) early-returns with a warning when Enabled is false, so Outbox/Inbox DbSets are not populated in the current test flow — no code path writes an OutboxMessage row while outbox:enabled=false. No test project registers a test-only IEventHandler<T>, message sink, or collector to capture published events; grepping for IEventHandler< and IMessageBroker in *IntegrationTests*/*Tests* projects only turns up production event handlers (GroupCreatedHandler, GroupDeletedHandler, GroupMemberAddedHandler, GroupMemberRemovedHandler, UserSignedUpHandler) and decorators, plus test code that (a) resolves the real IEventHandler<GroupDeleted> from DI and invokes it directly (GroupDeletedHandlerTests.InvokeHandlerAsync), or (b) polls read-model DB tables populated by the real async-dispatched handlers (GroupReadModelEventHandlerTests, EventPublishingTests use a WaitUntilAsync poll loop of up to 3-6 seconds against ResourcesDbContext read models) as the observable proof that an event was published/handled — there is no dedicated event-capturing sink. The Resources IntegrationTests are structured as: TestClient class ResourcesTestClient (wraps ManagementGroups HTTP calls plus ResourcesDbContext query helpers), a user factory ResourcesUserFactory (inserts a management_groups.user_read_models row via raw SQL and mints a JWT, no cross-module type import) and a data-seeding factory ResourcesGroupReadModelFactory (writes GroupReadModel/GroupMemberReadModel rows directly via ResourcesDbContext, bypassing the event pipeline), and an IntegrationTestCollection collection-fixture definition binding ThingsBooksyWebAppFactory via ICollectionFixture.
